concept: Warm aromatic spice-market palette for 360 Flavor & Spice: a deep paprika-red primary and rich turmeric-gold secondary set against creamy warm backgrounds, grounded by dark coffee ink and a warm cinnamon accent. Evokes an artisan, inviting, aromatic seasoning shop.
contrastNotes: All WCAG-AA targets verified. ink #2A1A10 on bg #FBF4E9 = 15.33:1 (>=7). ink-soft #6B4A30 on bg = 7.26:1 and on surface-alt = 6.55:1 (>=4.5). White on primary #B23A1E = 5.97:1; white on primary-dark = 8.68:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 5.46:1 (>=3). Extras: white on accent #A8521F = 5.40:1; turmeric secondary #9C6A12 gives white-on-secondary 4.68:1 and secondary-on-bg 4.31:1, so it is safe for text/icons and white-on-fill.
